create_parameter_sweep_read_json: create a ParameterSweep from a JSON file containing benchmark configurations
build_parameter_sweep_from_dict: build a ParameterSweep from a dictionary mapping experiment names to parameter sets
build_parameter_sweep_from_records: build a ParameterSweep from a list of parameter record dictionaries
run_parameter_sweep_apply_to_cmd: run apply_to_cmd on a ParameterSweepItem to inject parameters into a command-line argument list
test_parameter_sweep_has_param: test whether a ParameterSweepItem has a given parameter key with flexible dash-underscore matching
